name: Moonbrook Schoolhouse
summary: In Moonbrook's northwestern corner, Defias outlaws occupy the schoolhouse, with a small graveyard behind it. Stalvan Mistmantle once taught local children there.

sections.title: A Beacon Fallen into Shadow
sections.body: The mayor commissioned Stalvan Mistmantle to run a school after he began tutoring local children. In Moonbrook's brighter days, the town prospered and students filled the hall. Now outlaws occupy the building, while weathered headstones in the rear cemetery look out over Westfall's decline.

sections.title: Secrets in the Floorboards
sections.body: An old footlocker on the schoolhouse's main floor holds an unsent letter about Stalvan Mistmantle's arrival in Moonbrook. It tells how he tutored local children, then received the mayor's commission to build a new schoolhouse. A separate letter found later in Goldshire says regional troubles forced him to leave his post and seek work as a private tutor.

faq.q: What was this building originally used for?
faq.answer: Moonbrook's schoolhouse gave local children a formal education. Its broad hall resembles a town hall, reflecting the township's ambition and pride before its fall.
Stalvan Mistmantle was a learned scholar who became the schoolhouse's headmaster. Letters he left behind tell more of his career.

faq.q: Why is the schoolhouse abandoned now?
faq.answer: Economic strife brought Moonbrook down, and the Defias Brotherhood took over southern Westfall. The town's civic institutions fell, and bandits now overrun the abandoned schoolhouse.

faq.q: What can be found inside the schoolhouse today?
faq.answer: An old, dusty footlocker on the ground floor holds an unsent letter. Alliance investigators tracking Stalvan Mistmantle can find it inside.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, the abandoned schoolhouse shows how far Westfall has fallen from the Crown's protection. A center of learning now shelters outlaws.
